Split a raw droplet matrix into cells and empty droplets.

Source: R/io.R
split_droplets.Rd

Cells are either the barcodes you pass (e.g. from Cell Ranger's filtered matrix, EmptyDrops or CellBender calls – recommended) or, failing that, droplets with at least cell_min_umi counts. Empties are droplets whose total lies in empty_umi_range (SoupX's default soup range is 0-100 UMIs) and that are not cells. Droplets in between are ambiguous and are dropped from both sets rather than risk calling a cell "soup".

Usage

split_droplets(
  raw,
  cells = NULL,
  cell_min_umi = 500,
  empty_umi_range = c(1, 100)
)

Arguments

raw

genes x barcodes raw matrix (see read_10x_counts()).

cells

optional character vector of cell barcodes.

cell_min_umi

UMI threshold used only when cells is NULL.

empty_umi_range

inclusive UMI range for empty droplets. The lower bound defaults to 1 because zero-count barcodes carry no information.

Value

list(cells = genes x cells, empties = genes x droplets, summary).
